interface.description: Network interface on which to listen for mDNS queries (e.g., 'eth0', 'wlan0'). Must support multicast.

record_ttl.description: Time-to-live (TTL) in seconds for cached mDNS records.

max_cache_size.description: Maximum number of mDNS records to cache. Older entries are evicted on overflow.

reflect_ptr.description: Whether to reflect PTR (service discovery) mDNS queries across interfaces.

reflect_a_aaaa.description: Whether to reflect A and AAAA (hostname resolution) mDNS queries across interfaces.

forward_domains.description: List of domains (e.g., 'local', 'home.arpa') to forward; if empty, all domains are forwarded (unless suppressed).

suppress_domains.description: List of domains to suppress — never reflected, even if matched by forward_domains.

rate_limit_qps.description: Maximum mDNS queries per second allowed per source IP address.

max_qps.description: Overall maximum mDNS queries per second across all sources (0 = no global limit).

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: 'debug' for full detail, 'info' for normal operation, 'warn'/'error' for issues only.

log_file.description: Path to write logs (e.g., '/var/log/mdns-reflector.log'). Leave empty to log to stderr.
